description: ENS v2 contracts on Hardhat 3, from the contracts/ workspace of a bun monorepo, including their Solidity tests and Vitest integration suite.
defaultCommand: npx hardhat test && npx vitest run

reset files & cache.command: git checkout -- test/unit/utils/LibLabel.t.sol test/unit/migration/LockedMigrationController.t.sol src/registry/interfaces/IRegistry.sol && npx hardhat clean

edit & compile Solidity test with min de.command: printf "\n// hardhat benchmark edit\n" >> test/unit/utils/LibLabel.t.sol && npx hardhat compile

edit & compile Solidity test with max de.command: printf "\n// hardhat benchmark edit\n" >> test/unit/migration/LockedMigrationController.t.sol && npx hardhat compile

edit & compile Solidity contract: src/re.command: printf "\n// hardhat benchmark edit\n" >> src/registry/interfaces/IRegistry.sol && npx hardhat compile
